name: Sweet Revenge
source:
You peacefully lived with your family in the Seigoka neighborhood. One day your parents suddenly disappeared. They left you a great legacy. You don't need to work even for a day to live the rest of your life. But being only a kid, it meant nothing to you. You are adopted by your neighbor Tondas. Time has passed, and you are an adult now. Try to discover the mystery of your parent's disappearance; While doing so, it doesn't hurt to take revenge for what was done to you while you were young and naive. Does it?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/RhodiumRho]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你原本与家人在圣丘街区过着平静和睦的生活。某一天，你的父母突然人间蒸发，给你留下了一笔巨额遗产——下半辈子哪怕一天班也不上，都足够你衣食无忧。可对当时尚且年幼的你而言，这笔财富毫无意义。邻居唐达斯收养了你；斗转星移，如今你已长大成人。设法查明父母当年离奇失踪的真相吧；顺道趁此机会，向那些趁你年少天真时欺辱过你的人好好讨回公道，也没什么不好吧？

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/RhodiumRho]Patreon[/url]]
